chapter_title.ar: باب مَوْلِدِ أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ صَلَوَاتُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ

gradings: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (283/ 5)

translations.bn: আমাদের কিছু সাথী, আহমদ ইবন মুহাম্মদ থেকে, তিনি আলী ইবন আল-হাকাম থেকে, তিনি সফওয়ান আল-জাম্মাল থেকে, তিনি বলেন:
translations.de: Eine Anzahl unserer Gefährten, von Ahmad ibn Muhammad, von ʿAli ibn al-Ḥakam, von Ṣafwān al-Jammāl, der sagte:
translations.en: A number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Ṣafwān al-Jammāl, who said:
translations.es: Un grupo de nuestros compañeros, de Ahmad ibn Muhammad, de ʿAli ibn al-Ḥakam, de Ṣafwān al-Jammāl, quien dijo:
translations.fa: تعدادی از یاران ما، از احمد بن محمد، از علی بن الحکم، از صفوان الجمال، که گفت:
translations.fr: Un certain nombre de nos compagnons, d’Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, de ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, de Ṣafwān al-Jammāl, qui a dit :
translations.id: Sejumlah sahabat kami, dari Ahmad ibn Muhammad, dari ʿAli ibn al-Hakam, dari Safwan al-Jammal, yang berkata:
translations.ru: Некоторые из наших сподвижников, от Ахмада ибн Мухаммада, от Али ибн аль-Хакама, от Сафвана аль-Джаммала, который сказал:
translations.tr: Ashabımızdan bir grup, Ahmed ibn Muhammed’den, o Ali ibn el-Hakam’dan, o Safvan el-Cemmal’den rivayet etti ki, dedi:
translations.ur: ہمارے بعض اصحاب، احمد بن محمد سے، وہ علی بن الحکم سے، وہ صفوان الجمال سے، انہوں نے کہا:
translations.zh: 我们的一些同伴，传自AhmadibnMuhammad，传自ʿAlibnal-Ḥakam，传自Ṣafwānal-Jammāl，他说：

translations.bn: আমি, আমির এবং আবদুল্লাহ ইবন জুদাআহ আল-আজদী আবু আবদিল্লাহ عليه السلام-এর উপস্থিতিতে ছিলাম। তিনি বললেন: তখন আমির তাঁকে বলল, “আমি আপনার জন্য উৎসর্গিত হই, লোকেরা বলে যে আমীরুল মুমিনীন عليه السلام-কে আর-রাহবায় দাফন করা হয়েছে।”
translations.de: Ich, ʿĀmir und ʿAbdullāh ibn Judhāʿah al-Azdī befanden uns in der Gegenwart von Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام. Er sagte: Dann sagte ʿĀmir zu ihm: „Ich möge für dich geopfert werden, die Leute behaupten, dass Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام in al-Raḥbah begraben wurde.“
translations.en: I, and ʿĀmir, and ʿAbdullāh ibn Judhāʿah al-Azdī were in the presence of Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام. He said: Then ʿĀmir said to him, “May I be sacrificed for you, the people claim that Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام was buried in al-Raḥbah.”
translations.es: Yo, ʿĀmir y ʿAbdullāh ibn Judhāʿah al-Azdī estábamos en presencia de Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام. Él dijo: Entonces ʿĀmir le dijo: “Que yo sea sacrificado por ti, la gente afirma que Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام fue enterrado en al-Raḥbah.”
translations.fa: من و عامر و عبدالله بن جذاعهٔ ازدی نزد ابوعبدالله علیه السلام بودیم. فرمود: پس عامر به او گفت: فدایت شوم، مردم گمان می‌کنند امیرالمؤمنین علیه السلام در رحبه دفن شده است.
translations.fr: Moi, ʿĀmir et ʿAbdullāh ibn Judhāʿah al-Azdī étions en présence d’Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام. Il dit : Alors ʿĀmir lui dit : « Que je sois sacrifié pour vous, les gens prétendent qu’Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام a été enterré à al-Raḥbah. »
translations.id: Aku, ʿĀmir, dan ʿAbdullāh ibn Judhāʿah al-Azdī berada di hadapan Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام. Beliau bersabda: Lalu ʿĀmir berkata kepadanya, “Aku tebusan bagimu, orang-orang mengira bahwa Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام dikuburkan di al-Raḥbah.”
translations.ru: Я, ʿĀmir и ʿAbdullāh ибн Джудаʿа аль-Азди были у Абу ʿАбдуллаха عليه السلام. Он сказал: Тогда ʿĀmir сказал ему: «Да буду я принесён тебе в жертву, люди утверждают, что Амир аль-Муʾминин عليه السلام был похоронен в ар-Рахбе».
translations.tr: Ben, ʿĀmir ve ʿAbdullāh ibn Judhāʿah el-Ezdî, Ebû ʿAbdillâh عليه السلام’ın huzurundaydık. O buyurdu ki: Sonra ʿĀmir ona dedi: “Size feda olayım, insanlar Emîru’l-Mü’minîn عليه السلام’ın er-Rahbe’de defnedildiğini iddia ediyorlar.”
translations.ur: میں، اور عامر، اور عبداللہ بن جذاعہ الأزدی، ابو عبداللہ علیہ السلام کی خدمت میں تھے۔ انہوں نے فرمایا: پھر عامر نے ان سے کہا: میں آپ پر قربان، لوگ یہ گمان کرتے ہیں کہ امیر المؤمنین علیہ السلام کو الرَّحبہ میں دفن کیا گیا تھا۔
translations.zh: 我、ʿĀmir和ʿAbdullāhibnJudhāʿahal-Azdī在AbūʿAbdillāh عليه السلام面前。他说：然后ʿĀmir对他说：“愿我为你牺牲，人们声称Amīral-Muʾminīn عليه السلام被埋葬在al-Raḥbah。”

translations.bn: তিনি عليه السلام বললেন: “না।” সে বলল: “তাহলে তাঁকে কোথায় দাফন করা হয়েছিল?” তিনি عليه السلام বললেন: “যখন তাঁর মৃত্যু হলো, হাসান عليه السلام তাঁকে বহন করে কুফার পেছনে, নাজাফের কাছে, আল-গারির বাম দিকে, আল-হীরার ডান দিকে নিয়ে গেলেন এবং তাঁকে সাদা ঢিবিগুলোর মাঝে দাফন করলেন।”
translations.de: Er عليه السلام sagte: „Nein.“ Er sagte: „Wo wurde er dann begraben?“ Er عليه السلام sagte: „Als er starb, trug ihn al-Ḥasan عليه السلام und brachte ihn hinter al-Kūfah, nahe al-Najaf, links von al-Gharī, rechts von al-Ḥīrah, und begrub ihn zwischen weißen Hügeln.“
translations.en: He عليه السلام said, “No.” He said, “Then where was he buried?” He عليه السلام said, “When he passed away, al-Ḥasan عليه السلام carried him and brought him to the back of al-Kūfah, near al-Najaf, to the left of al-Gharī, to the right of al-Ḥīrah, and buried him between white mounds.”
translations.es: Él عليه السلام dijo: “No.” Él dijo: “Entonces, ¿dónde fue enterrado?” Él عليه السلام dijo: “Cuando falleció, al-Ḥasan عليه السلام lo llevó y lo condujo a la parte posterior de al-Kūfah, cerca de al-Najaf, a la izquierda de al-Gharī, a la derecha de al-Ḥīrah, y lo enterró entre montículos blancos.”
translations.fa: فرمود: «نه.» گفت: «پس او را کجا دفن کردند؟» فرمود: «وقتی از دنیا رفت، حسن علیه السلام او را برداشت و به پشت کوفه، نزدیک نجف، در سمت چپ غری و در سمت راست حیره آورد و او را میان تپه‌های سفید دفن کرد.»
translations.fr: Il عليه السلام dit : « Non. » Il dit : « Alors où a-t-il été enterré ? » Il عليه السلام dit : « Lorsqu’il mourut, al-Ḥasan عليه السلام le transporta et l’amena à l’arrière de al-Kūfah, près de al-Najaf, à gauche de al-Gharī, à droite de al-Ḥīrah, et l’enterra entre des tertres blancs. »
translations.id: Beliau عليه السلام bersabda: “Tidak.” Ia berkata: “Kalau begitu, di mana beliau dikuburkan?” Beliau عليه السلام bersabda: “Ketika beliau wafat, al-Ḥasan عليه السلام membawanya dan membawanya ke belakang al-Kūfah, dekat al-Najaf, di sebelah kiri al-Gharī, di sebelah kanan al-Ḥīrah, lalu menguburkannya di antara gundukan-gundukan putih.”
translations.ru: Он عليه السلام сказал: «Нет». Он сказал: «Тогда где же он был похоронен?» Он عليه السلام сказал: «Когда он скончался, аль-Хасан عليه السلام понёс его и привёл к задней части аль-Куфы, близ ан-Наджафа, слева от аль-Гари, справа от аль-Хиры, и похоронил его между белыми холмами».
translations.tr: O عليه السلام buyurdu: “Hayır.” O dedi: “Öyleyse nereye defnedildi?” O عليه السلام buyurdu: “Vefat ettiğinde, el-Hasan عليه السلام onu taşıdı ve Kûfe’nin arka tarafına, Necef’e yakın, el-Garî’nin soluna, el-Hîre’nin sağına getirdi ve onu beyaz tümsekler arasına defnetti.”
translations.ur: انہوں نے فرمایا: نہیں۔ اس نے کہا: پھر انہیں کہاں دفن کیا گیا؟ انہوں نے فرمایا: جب ان کا انتقال ہوا تو حسن علیہ السلام انہیں اٹھا کر کوفہ کے پچھلے حصے، نجف کے قریب، غری کے بائیں جانب اور حیرہ کے دائیں جانب لے آئے، پھر انہیں سفید ٹیلوں کے درمیان دفن کیا۔
translations.zh: 他 عليه السلام说：“没有。”他说：“那么他被埋在哪里？”他 عليه السلام说：“当他去世时，al-Ḥasan عليه السلام把他抬走，带到al-Kūfah后方，靠近al-Najaf，在al-Gharī左边、al-Ḥīrah右边，并把他埋在白色土丘之间。”

translations.bn: তিনি বললেন: তারপর পরে আমি সেই স্থানে গেলাম এবং তার মধ্যে একটি নির্দিষ্ট স্থান অনুমান করলাম। তারপর আমি তাঁর কাছে এসে তাঁকে জানালাম, তখন তিনি আমাকে বললেন: “তুমি সঠিক বলেছ। আল্লাহ তোমার প্রতি রহম করুন,” তিনবার।
translations.de: Er sagte: Dann ging ich später zu dem Ort und vermutete darin eine bestimmte Stelle. Danach kam ich zu ihm und berichtete es ihm, und er sagte zu mir: „Du hast recht. Möge Allah sich deiner erbarmen“, dreimal.
translations.en: He said: Then later, I went to the location and supposed a particular place within it. Then I came to him and informed him, so he said to me, “You were correct. May Allah have mercy on you,” three times.
translations.es: Él dijo: Luego, más tarde, fui al lugar e imaginé un sitio concreto dentro de él. Después fui a él y se lo informé, y me dijo: “Has acertado. Que Allah tenga misericordia de ti”, tres veces.
translations.fa: گفت: سپس بعداً به آن مکان رفتم و جایی را در آن حدس زدم. آنگاه نزد او آمدم و او را خبر دادم، پس به من فرمود: «درست گفتی، خدا بر تو رحمت آورد»، سه بار.
translations.fr: Il dit : Puis, plus tard, je me rendis à l’endroit et j’en supposai un lieu précis. Ensuite je vins le lui rapporter, et il me dit : « Tu as vu juste. Qu’Allah te fasse miséricorde », trois fois.
translations.id: Ia berkata: Kemudian setelah itu, aku pergi ke lokasi itu dan memperkirakan suatu tempat di dalamnya. Lalu aku datang kepadanya dan memberitahukannya, maka ia berkata kepadaku, “Engkau benar. Semoga Allah merahmatimu,” tiga kali.
translations.ru: Он сказал: Затем позже я отправился к тому месту и предположил в нём определённое место. Потом я пришёл к нему и сообщил ему, и он сказал мне: «Ты попал верно. Да помилует тебя Аллах», три раза.
translations.tr: O dedi: Sonra daha sonra o yere gittim ve orada belirli bir yeri tahmin ettim. Sonra onun yanına geldim ve ona haber verdim; bana şöyle dedi: “Doğru bildin. Allah sana rahmet etsin,” üç kez.
translations.ur: انہوں نے کہا: پھر بعد میں میں اس جگہ گیا اور اس میں ایک خاص مقام کا اندازہ کیا۔ پھر میں ان کے پاس آیا اور انہیں خبر دی، تو انہوں نے مجھ سے فرمایا: تم نے درست پایا، اللہ تم پر رحم کرے، تین مرتبہ۔
translations.zh: 他说：后来，我去了那个地方，并推测出其中一个具体位置。然后我来到他那里并告诉了他，于是他对我说：“你说对了。愿真主怜悯你。”三次。

en.أَصَبْتَ: you were correct; you identified it accurately
en.أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Amīr al-Muʾminīn, the title referring here to Imam ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام
en.النَّجَفِ: Najaf, the region near the burial place mentioned in the report
en.الْحِيرَةِ: al-Ḥīrah, another landmark marking the area
en.الْغَرِيِّ: al-Gharī, a landmark used to identify the location
en.رَكَوَاتٍ بِيضٍ: white mounds or elevated white patches of land

seo_questions.bn: আল-কাফি অনুযায়ী আমীরুল মুমিনীন আলী عليه السلام কোথায় দাফন করা হয়েছিল?
seo_questions.de: Wo wurde Amīr al-Muʾminīn ʿAlī عليه السلام laut al-Kāfī begraben?
seo_questions.en: Where was Amīr al-Muʾminīn ʿAlī عليه السلام buried according to al-Kāfī?
seo_questions.es: Según al-Kāfī, ¿dónde fue enterrado Amīr al-Muʾminīn ʿAlī عليه السلام?
seo_questions.fa: بر اساس الکافی، امیرالمؤمنین علی علیه السلام کجا دفن شد؟
seo_questions.fr: Selon al-Kāfī, où Amīr al-Muʾminīn ʿAlī عليه السلام a-t-il été enterré ?
seo_questions.id: Menurut al-Kāfī, di mana Amīr al-Muʾminīn ʿAlī عليه السلام dikuburkan?
seo_questions.ru: Где, согласно аль-Кафи, был похоронен Амир аль-Муʾминин ʿАли عليه السلام?
seo_questions.tr: el-Kâfî’ye göre Amîru’l-Mü’minîn ʿAlî عليه السلام nereye defnedildi?
seo_questions.ur: الکافی کے مطابق امیر المؤمنین علی علیہ السلام کو کہاں دفن کیا گیا تھا؟
seo_questions.zh: 根据al-Kāfī，Amīral-MuʾminīnʿAlī عليه السلام被埋葬在哪里？

summaries.bn: এই হাদিসে ইমাম আল-সাদিক عليه السلام থেকে আমীরুল মুমিনীন আলী ইবন আবি তালিব عليه السلام-এর কবরের স্থান সম্পর্কে একটি বর্ণনা এসেছে। এতে কবরকে নাজাফের কাছে, কুফার পেছনে বলে চিহ্নিত করা হয়েছে এবং বর্ণনাকারীর পরবর্তী সময়ে স্থানটি শনাক্ত করার বিষয়টি উল্লেখ করা হয়েছে, যা ইমাম عليه السلام নিশ্চিত করেছেন।
summaries.de: Dieser Hadith überliefert einen Bericht von Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام über den Begräbnisort von Amīr al-Muʾminīn ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام. Er bezeichnet das Grab als nahe al-Najaf, hinter al-Kūfah, und hält die spätere Wiedererkennung des Ortes durch den Überlieferer fest, die der Imam عليه السلام bestätigte.
summaries.en: This hadith narrates a report from Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام concerning the burial place of Amīr al-Muʾminīn ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام. It identifies the grave as being near al-Najaf, behind al-Kūfah, and records the narrator’s later recognition of the site, which the Imam عليه السلام affirmed.
summaries.es: Este hadiz narra un informe del Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام acerca del lugar de enterramiento de Amīr al-Muʾminīn ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام. Identifica la tumba como estando cerca de al-Najaf, detrás de al-Kūfah, y registra el posterior reconocimiento del sitio por parte del narrador, que el Imam عليه السلام confirmó.
summaries.fa: این حدیث از امام صادق علیه السلام دربارهٔ محل دفن امیرالمؤمنین علی بن ابی‌طالب علیه السلام گزارشی نقل می‌کند. در آن، قبر در نزدیکی نجف و پشت کوفه معرفی شده و شناسایی بعدیِ آن مکان توسط راوی ثبت شده است که امام علیه السلام آن را تأیید فرمود.
summaries.fr: Ce hadith rapporte un récit de l’Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام concernant le lieu de sépulture d’Amīr al-Muʾminīn ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام. Il identifie la tombe comme étant près de al-Najaf, derrière al-Kūfah, et relate la reconnaissance ultérieure du site par le narrateur, que l’Imam عليه السلام a confirmée.
summaries.id: Hadis ini meriwayatkan laporan dari Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام tentang tempat pemakaman Amīr al-Muʾminīn ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام. Riwayat ini menyebutkan makamnya berada dekat al-Najaf, di belakang al-Kūfah, dan mencatat pengenalan kemudian oleh perawi terhadap lokasi itu, yang dibenarkan oleh Imam عليه السلام.
summaries.ru: Этот хадис передаёт сообщение от имама аль-Ṣādiq عليه السلام о месте захоронения Амир аль-Муʾминина ʿАли ибн Аби Талиба عليه السلام. В нём могила определяется как находящаяся близ ан-Наджафа, позади аль-Куфы, и приводится последующее узнавание этого места передатчиком, которое имам عليه السلام подтвердил.
summaries.tr: Bu hadis, İmam es-Sâdık عليه السلام’dan Amîru’l-Mü’minîn ʿAlî ibn Ebî Tâlib عليه السلام’ın kabir yeri hakkında bir rivayet nakleder. Kabri Necef yakınında, Kûfe’nin arkasında olarak belirtir ve ravinin daha sonra bu yeri tanımasını, İmam’ın عليه السلام tasdik ettiğini kaydeder.
summaries.ur: یہ حدیث امام صادق علیہ السلام سے امیر المؤمنین علی بن ابی طالب علیہ السلام کی قبر کے مقام کے بارے میں روایت کرتی ہے۔ اس میں قبر کو نجف کے قریب، کوفہ کے پیچھے بتایا گیا ہے، اور راوی کے بعد میں اس جگہ کی پہچان کو نقل کیا گیا ہے جس کی امام علیہ السلام نے تصدیق فرمائی۔
summaries.zh: 这段圣训转述了Imamal-Ṣādiq عليه السلام关于Amīral-MuʾminīnʿAlīibnAbīṬālib عليه السلام安葬地点的记载。它指出其陵墓在al-Najaf附近、al-Kūfah后方，并记录了传述者后来认出该地点，而Imam عليه السلام对此予以确认。

gradings: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (283/ 5)
text: كُنْتُ أَنَا وَ عَامِرٌ وَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جُذَاعَةَ الْأَزْدِيُّ عِنْدَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) قَالَ فَقَالَ لَهُ عَامِرٌ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ إِنَّ النَّاسَ يَزْعُمُونَ أَنَّ أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ( عليه السلام ) دُفِنَ بِالرَّحْبَةِ قَالَ لَا قَالَ فَأَيْنَ دُفِنَ قَالَ إِنَّهُ لَمَّا مَاتَ احْتَمَلَهُ الْحَسَنُ ( عليه السلام ) فَأَتَى بِهِ ظَهْرَ الْكُوفَةِ قَرِيباً مِنَ النَّجَفِ يَسْرَةً عَنِ الْغَرِيِّ يَمْنَةً عَنِ الْحِيرَةِ فَدَفَنَهُ بَيْنَ رَكَوَاتٍ بِيضٍ
قَالَ فَلَمَّا كَانَ بَعْدُ ذَهَبْتُ إِلَى الْمَوْضِعِ فَتَوَهَّمْتُ مَوْضِعاً مِنْهُ ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُهُ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ فَقَالَ لِي أَصَبْتَ رَحِمَكَ اللَّهُ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ .

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Safwan Al Jammal who said,

‘I, and Aamir, and Abdullah Bin Juza’at Al-Azdy were in the presence of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>. So Aamir said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! The people are alleging that Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> is buried at Al-Rahba’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No’. He said, ‘So where is he<sup>asws</sup> buried?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When he<sup>asws</sup> passed away, Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> carried him<sup>asws</sup> and came with him<sup>asws</sup> to behind Al-Kufa, near from Al-Najaf, left of Al-Ghary, right of Al-Hira. So he<sup>asws</sup> buried him<sup>asws</sup> between the two white dunes’.

He (the narrator) said, ‘So when it was afterwards, I went to the place. So I suspected a place from it. Then I went over to him<sup>asws</sup> and informed him<sup>asws</sup>, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘You hit it. May Allah<sup>azwj</sup> have Mercy on you’ – thrice’.
en.sarwar: 4. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Barqi from Ahmad ibn Zayd al-Naysaburi who has said that narrated to me ‘Umar ibn Ibrahim al-Hashimi from ‘Abd al-Malik ibn ‘Umar from ’Asid ibn Safwan the companion of the Messenger of Allah who has said the following. “On the day that Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) passed away the place shock as people wept and cried and they were frightened like al-Thaqafi day the Holy Prophet (s.a) passed away. A man came weeping who seemed in a hurry and saying the words of the Holy Quran, “We are the servants of God and to Him we shall all return.” [2:156] He continued, “Today the government as succession of that of the Holy Prophet (s.a) is discontinued.” He stood at the door of the house in which Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) was and said, “May Allah grant you blessing, O abu al-Hassan. You were the first in the nation who accepted Islam and were of the purest faith among them. You were of the most solid certainty and feared Allah the most among them. The degree of your hard work (for the cause of Allah) was the greatest and you were the most cautious in protecting the Messenger of Allah among them. You were the most trusted in the affairs of his companions and of the most distinguished in excellence, of the most honorable past credentials, of the highest degree of virtue and the closest as relatives to the Messenger of Allah among them. You were the most similar among them to him (the Messenger of Allah) in the matters of providing guidance, moral discipline, mannerism and deeds. You were the most precious to him (the Messenger of Allah) among them, in value and the most honorable to him among them. May Allah grant you good rewards on behalf of Islam, His Messenger and the Muslims. You exercised strength when his (the Messenger of Allah’s) companions became weak. You would come out (to face the enemy) when they showed humiliation, you rose up whenever showed laziness. You maintained steadfastness in adherence to the system of the Messenger of Allah whenever his companions attended othewise. You, indeed, were his undisputed successor and you did not cause strife 9in the community) despite the mischief of the hypocrites, of the anger of the unbelievers, the dislike of the jealous ones, and lowliness of the transgressors. You stood firm for the truth when they failed, spoke clearly when they became speechless, marched forwards in the light of Allah and they halted and if they followed you they found the right guidance. You were the softest in tone and of the highest degree of prayer among them, of the smallest amount of speech and of the most correct and valid statements. You were of the greatest ideas, of the bravest heart, of the most solid certainty, of the best of deeds and the most knowledgeable of the issues among them. You, by Allah, were the lead figure in religion at first and at last. You were the first when people digressed in chaos and the last when they failed. Your as a kind father to the believers as they become dependent up on you and you bore such burdens that others felt much weak to carry. Your protected what they had lost and guarded what they had ignored. You tightened your belt when they accumulated (wealth with greed), you rose high when they despaired (in humiliation). You exercised patience when they rushed and you achieved what they had never dreamed to achieve and through you they gained what they had never expected to gain. You were as pouring calamity and disaster up on the unbelievers and the fortress and support for the believers. You were invented for the task of Leadership with Divine Authority with its blessing and you succeeded to achieve its awards, established its prerequisite and left with its distinctions. Your evidence in support your divine Authority never last its sharp edge and your heart never wavered, your intelligence never weakened, your soul did not falter or become frightened. You were like a mountain that strong winds could not move. It is just as the Holy Prophet (s.a) has said, “People lived secure in your company and their property well preserved in your hands.” You were just as the Holy Prophet (s.a) has said, “Physically weak but very strong to support the cause of Allah, of a very humble soul, but very great in the sight of Allah, the chief on earth and majestic in the sight of the believers. No one could ever find faults with you or advance criticism. No one could ever involve you in corruption. You never showed anyone (corrupt) compliance. The weak and feeble to you were strong popular until you would restore their rights and the powerful and popular were weak and feeble to you until you would make to yield to others rights. People of close relation or otherwise were all equal to you in such cases. You aimed the truth, the true and kindness. Your words were law and final and your commands were based on forbearance and determination your view was knowledge and the final decision in what you would do. The system is established, the pitfalls are routed, the fires (of mischief) are extinguished, religious issues are balanced and through you Islam has become strong. The guidance of Allah has become manifest even though the unbelievers dislike. Islam, the through you, and the believers are strengthened. You have raced (for Divine excellence) a long race and cause a great deal of weariness to those behind you. Losing you can never be compensated with weeping and your death is a great issue in heavens and it has threatened the people (with emergence of chaos). “We are the servants of God and to Him we shall all return.” [2:156] We accept the decision of Allah and submit to His commands. By Allah, the Muslims will never find any one like you. You were a fortress and the stronghold like a heavy mountain and the intense anger for the unbelievers. May Allah join you with His Holy Prophet (s.a). May Allah not deprive us of your rewards and keep us safe against mis-guidance after you. People remained silent until he finished his words. He wept and the companions of the Messenger of Allah wept. Thereafter, they searched for him but he was nowhere to be found.”
